I like ginger ale.

2 gallons water 260 g ginger root sliced or grated (sliced results in less settlement in the bottles but also less ginger flavor) 2 cups unprocessed sugar (brownish still has molasses in it otherwise also add 1/8 cup molasses) 2 cups fresh lemon juice (no preservatives or sulfites they kill the ginger bug!) 2 teaspoons non ionized salt 1 cup ginger bug

Bring water to boiling. Set to simmer add the ginger root. Let it simmer a couple hours. Pull off heat add sugar, and salt. Let cool to room temp add lemon juice and ginger bug. Bottle and wait a few days for it to carbonate! Once desired carbonation reached put in the fridge. DO NOT FORGET ABOUT THESE IF BOTTLED...

I use 1 plastic soda bottle to test for carbonation (when firm like a soda time to refridgerate). The rest is bottled in 12 oz beer bottles.
